lockedInvariants: Local LLM model artifacts live on the cognitive/2D side.
Every carrier action releases addressed swarm pieces before it can affect the embodied field.
LLMs do not directly mutate the embodied field.
The embodied field cycles swarm pieces through registered contact rules, graph traces, compositions, activation changes, and emergent channels.
Embodied feedback returns to the originating carriers as relationship experience.
Carrier relationship experience persists across restarts and is eligible to become descendant-model training material.
Descendant models are new artifacts with parent fingerprints; parent artifacts are preserved.
Peer-mesh learning capsules are witness-checked and identity-matched before becoming local learning observations.
Peer evidence never silently replaces local model fitness.
Runtime state is saved as append-only versioned snapshots.
No hosted inference, Hugging Face API, GitHub API, Supabase, or central server is required after local model artifacts and app dependencies are present.
Carrier count is configuration, not a law. Four dimensional carriers are the minimum baseline; larger carrier fields can be declared without changing the runtime.
